verdict.rationale: Unleash's environments give each lifecycle stage its own flag configuration, so you can enable a flag in development or test without enabling it in production. Backend tokens are scoped to a single environment, which keeps test clients away from production config. A Docker self-host or a ready-to-use hosted instance provides a separate place to experiment. Missing for 10: an explicit dedicated sandbox or isolated-data mode (environments share one instance and the same flag definitions), evidence that the MCP server or agent workflows can be restricted to non-production environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
